bullets: Un sistema rápido cruza el lunes con humedad y dinámica limitadas: solo chubascos ligeros y acumulaciones mínimas en terreno alto.
Una cresta de alta presión trae tiempo seco desde el martes hasta al menos media semana.
Para Thanksgiving y el fin de semana sigue posible un patrón más activo, pero los ensambles no coinciden (confianza baja).

sections.Key Messages:
- Generally dry and cooler conditions return for Sunday.
- A quick moving system will bring areas of rain and snow
  showers for Monday.
- Active weather remains possible for Thanksgiving week, but
  some details still remain uncertain. Stay tuned for updates to
  timing and impacts as they become available.
sections.Discussion:
Issued at 1024 AM MST Sun Nov 22 2026
DRY AND COOL FOR SUNDAY:
Dry and cool weather is expected for Sunday with a weak ridge moving
through the Intermountain West. Mid to high level clouds will move
in from the west through the day as our next storm system
approaches.
QUICK MOVING SYSTEM FOR MONDAY:
Moisture will begin to move into the area Sunday night as a weak low-
amplitude trough moves through and brings southwesterly flow.
This system will be fast moving with moisture and lift remaining
limited. High-res models begin to develop light showers Monday
morning over the Four Corners. This will bring a rain/snow mix
for valley locations with mostly snow expected in the higher
terrain above 6000 ft. There are some pockets of weak
instability that may develop Monday afternoon (SBCAPE 50-100
J/kg) over southwest Colorado creating the possibility of
locally heavier snowfall. The best chance for accumulating snow
remains over the San Juans but accumulations are expected to be
mostly light and be below advisory levels.
DRY AGAIN MIDWEEK, ACTIVE WEATHER POSSIBLE FOR END OF THE WEEK:
By Tuesday morning, the trough will move east of our
area, and ridging builds in. Conditions through Wednesday are
expected to be dry with temperatures remaining near or slightly
below normal. The rest of the forecast period may remain active
with some deterministic guidance showing another weak system
for Thanksgiving Day. Northwesterly flow will primarily bring
impacts to the Park Range, but exact details are uncertain at
this time. Another system is possible next weekend, but ensemble
members are still showing significant disagreement. Stay tuned
on potential impacts to holiday travel plans.
sections.Aviation:
Issued at 446 PM MST Sun Nov 22 2026
SCT to BKN mid and high level clouds are expected overnight. A
quick-moving weather system will bring lower clouds and
precipitation from the southwest to northeast tomorrow. Impacts
become possible at KTEX and KDRO around 12Z, KASE, KRIL, KGJT,
KMTJ, and KGUC around 18Z, and KEGE around 21Z. So, PROB30 has
been included for these sites for lowered ceilings and
visibility from snow or rain/snow. Drops below ILS breakpoints
and MVFR/IFR conditions are possible at impacted sites.
Otherwise, VFR conditions are expected. Winds will generally be
light.
